description: This file is a Streamlit application script for a medical exam preparation chatbot that implements Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG). It manages UI layout, session state, external API calls to OpenAI, and integrates with a vector store for document retrieval, specifically designed for chapter-based textbook content.

classes.name: LocalVectorStore
classes.description: A class managing vector storage and similarity search for document chunks.

classes.name: EmbeddingManager
classes.description: A class responsible for generating embeddings for text queries.

methods.name: generate_rag_answer
methods.description: Asynchronous function that performs document retrieval based on query embedding, constructs a context, and calls OpenAI API to generate an answer.
